       else
         git push --force origin "github/$SYNC_BRANCH:refs/heads/$SYNC_BRANCH"

+
+# argo-diff issue #160 Phase 0 spike - not for main.
+phase0-spike:
+  image: alpine:latest@sha256:294b683cb724975bec92580e1e685676bd4b50bda910ddb8c51d4cabeaec77e6
+  rules:
+    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
+  variables:
+    GIT_STRATEGY: none
+  script:
+    - apk add --no-cache curl >/dev/null
+    - |
+      echo "=== CI env (secret-like names redacted) ==="
+      env | grep -E '^(CI|GITLAB)_' | sort | while IFS= read -r line; do
+        name="${line%%=*}"
+        case "$name" in
+          *TOKEN*|*PASSWORD*|*SECRET*|*KEY*|*JWT*|*AUTH*) echo "$name=<redacted>" ;;
+          *) printf '%s\n' "$line" ;;
+        esac
+      done
+      echo "=== end CI env ==="
+    - |
+      A="$CI_API_V4_URL/projects/$CI_PROJECT_ID"
+      t() { echo "--- $1"; shift; curl -s -o /tmp/out -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' -H "JOB-TOKEN: $CI_JOB_TOKEN" "$@"; head -c 300 /tmp/out; echo; }
+      t "GET /user" "$CI_API_V4_URL/user"
+      t "GET MR" "$A/merge_requests/$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID"
+      t "GET MR diffs" "$A/merge_requests/$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID/diffs"
+      t "GET MR notes" "$A/merge_requests/$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID/notes"
+      t "POST MR note" -X POST --data-urlencode "body=CI_JOB_TOKEN note test (argo-diff #160 phase 0)" "$A/merge_requests/$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID/notes"
+      t "POST commit status" -X POST -d "state=success&name=argo-diff/job-token-test" "$A/statuses/$CI_COMMIT_SHA"
